description: An input_audio block in ogg, as DSPy renders an ogg/opus recording and as Gemini's Chat Completions server accepts it. The format reads as its true media type (audio/ogg), never relabelled; a builder that cannot send it raises (MAP-10), Gemini sends it as inlineData.

provenance.evidence: MAP-12 rule 4 as amended by changes/2026-09-29-input-audio-formats.md; the format value follows research/cloud-hosts/sources/vertex-openai-compat.md (input_audio.format: 'Using Gemini, all valid MIME types are supported'); the expectation was written by hand and checked against the reference shim on 2026-09-29
